lead.title: Phoenix transports do not limit channel joins per connection, enabling process-exhaustion denial of service

commit.message:
Limit the number of channels a single transport process can join

This prevents a single client from opening an unbounded number of
channels (processes).

This prevents a single client from opening an unbounded number of
channels (processes).
